cohort: 1858 pregnant women who received two-step screening for gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) at Fooyin University Hospital from October 2015 to June 2020
finding: Women with GDM had higher incidences of cesarean section, preterm birth, neonatal LGA, and NICU admission, while women in the OGTT-1 group had a higher incidence of neonatal LGA compared to the control group.
